verdict.rationale: Base44 documents several programmatic surfaces. The SDK uses Base44 as a backend service with entity CRUD calls such as base44.entities.Task.create. The CLI creates projects, syncs data models and code, deploys resources and runs commands against any app on the account. A first-party MCP server exposes the account to AI assistants. Together these let an AI-native user drive the product without the editor UI. However, the OpenAPI probe found no published spec, and no raw REST API reference is evidenced, so the 'public API' is delivered mainly through the SDK, CLI and MCP wrappers. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/REST API reference, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API/SDK.
